data.title: Festive Free-For-All Starts Now: Play for Free until January 7!
data.summary: Get up to merry mischief and earn rewards in the first event.
data.content:
Play War Robots: Frontiers for free starting today! Everyone can experience the full Early Access version of the game until January 7 via MY.GAMES Launcher or the Steam Demo Version, even if they don’t own a Pioneer Pack.

Become a Pilot, assemble your mechs, and get ready for three weeks of special events, starting with…:

Bulwark Event (December 18–24) 

Build a Bulwark to surpass all others! Get the following by playing one match every day:

  • Day 1: Bulwark Legs (Robot Part)
  • Day 2: Bulwark Torso (Robot Part)
  • Day 3: Bulwark Shoulder (Robot Part)
  • Day 4: Bulwark Shoulder (Robot Part)
  • Day 5: Thunder x1 (Weapon)
  • Day 6: Thunder x1 (Weapon)
  • Day 7: Sora “Lioness” Sing (Pilot)

IMPORTANT: Rewards are subject to a progress wipe when Open Beta begins.

If you decide to take up residence in the Wild Ten, grab a Pioneer Pack to get a host of awesome in-game content along with full Early Access to War Robots: Frontiers via wrfrontiers.com and Steam.

Subscribe to the official War Robots: Frontiers newsletter to get more of the latest news like this straight to your inbox, follow the game on Twitter and Facebook, and join the official Discord server. You can also follow War Robots: Frontiers on Steam to get the latest news.
